bullets.content: [general] One factor per nonlinear_check; name it in the first message ('changed X from a to b') and write break-even first (+10% DOFs needs e down >=10% above g=2). Multi-factor ideas must first pass a free mesh() node-count and break-even screen. Report result in one line.

[general] One factor per experiment, written in the plan before meshing. After each solve: read top-5 hotspots and local h, view(kind=error, iso and -z). Compare best vs runner-up before submitting. Submit by score per DOF (on NL-scored tasks, by nonlinear e).

[general] Never re-solve or nonlinear_check a recipe whose e is recorded: meshing and ramp are deterministic (a1's 5737-node mesh gave 2.42% twice). Use the recorded e and DOFs as baseline; each check must be a new mesh/factor.

[general] Never submit last generation's recipe or a peer's unchanged (g7: 0.846, rank 4, no bonus; a1 and a2 tied 0.797). Submit the best CHECKED mesh that differs structurally; an explorer's new mesh is worth it if base >=90% of best (diversity +0.1).

[general] Spend all 6 nonlinear_checks; write the 6-slot schedule before the first mesh call: 1 control tweak, 2 fallback twin on another branch, 3-5 one-factor volume trims, 6 spare. Used 3 of 6 repeatedly. Spare checks go to new meshes.
[general] mesh() replaces the active mesh and solve() uses the LAST call. Re-issue the intended mesh() right before solve or nonlinear_check and confirm the node count matches.
[general] REPEATED: write the node gate (6000) next to every nonlinear_check. A mesh over the gate gets only a linear solve (total reaction f17+f34), never a check. 6847 nodes was checked wrongly.

[general] REPEATED: call view(kind=error, iso) on solve 1 (control), read hotspot h vs box size; then compare(1,n) per candidate. Lower f17+f34 reaction means less stiffness, a proxy for 1.0 mm error.

[general] Free-mesh scan before solving: node counts are non-monotone in box size (0.0039 gave 6838, 0.0040 gave 5474, 0.0041 gave 6235). Scan +/-0.0001 around every candidate; check nodes and min quality (>0.1) before spending a solve.

[general] Keep every promise in the opening plan. After the final solve call view(kind=error, view=z) and view(kind=stress, view=-z); read whether hotspots sit outside the 0.0028 pocket boxes or 0.004 carrier. Hotspot h >1.3x requested means under-resolved. Skipped before.
[general] When a tweak shows no energy change, stop and submit; spend spare solves on a bolder single change (e.g. finer root) rather than a marginal box extension.
[general] Compare solves by estimated score (error vs DOFs) before submitting. A small DOF drop with a larger error was not worth it.

[general] Spend spare nonlinear checks on bolder structural changes (no carrier, bore-flank box, neck boxes, h change >1.5x), not noise tweaks. Once a family lands within ±0.1 pt (2.52/2.54/2.55%), stop trims after the first. Before each check write expected e change; skip if <0.15 pt.
[general] Enforce your check gate: before each nonlinear_check write break-even = best product / nodes; refuse if below plausible floor. Mesh 6 (7657 nodes, break-even 1.84%) wasted a check.
[general] Before each check, free-mesh at least 4 small trims (e.g. carrier top at ±0.001) and pick the cheapest branch with q>=0.2. Saved 3% nodes at same error.

[general] Before spending free scans on a factor, check the allocation table: a factor assigned to a peer (arm size to a0, h to a3) wastes scans and creates ties. Scan your own factor or untouched volume trims.
[general] Obey your own quality gate: on this task every q<0.15 branch (h 0.0087, q 0.1445, 2.75%) was worse than q>=0.22 branches at similar nodes. Skip such meshes in checks.

[general] A compare() region marks where the field CHANGED, not where the error is. Place refinement from the solve's own top-5 hotspots and view(kind=error). Misreading a compare region made a run drop edge 18.
[general] 21.6k vs 16.7k DOFs gave only a 5.9% stress change; +29% DOFs not worth it. Decide by score per DOF.
[general] Mirror refinements across truly symmetric features (verify symmetry first), and rank candidates by e times DOFs, not e alone.
[general] Delivered size lags the request about 1.3-1.6x (bc0 sub-box 0.0016 gave h 0.0024-0.0026). Request about 0.7x the wanted local h and verify via 'element size near group' and hotspot h.

[general] Mesher branches decide cost more than sizes: same recipe gave 5743 or 6929 nodes for a 0.0003 pocket-size change; on bc0 5571 or 7281. Free-mesh a ±0.0003 size and ±0.0002-0.0005 h neighbourhood; solve the cheapest branch with q.min>=0.15; never one >10% above the cheapest.
[general] Point refinements and box radius are inert (bc0: nodes unchanged). Use {group} or {box} refinements for local size, and check every new parameter with a free mesh() node count.

[general] Edge refinements deliver poorly when hotspot sits 0.2-0.8 mm off the edge (edges 39/8 at 0.0026 gave h 0.0038-0.0040, 1.5x). Cover such bands with a box spanning the edge ±2 mm at the same size.

[general] Thin walls (~2.5 mm): if hotspot local h exceeds wall thickness, bending is under-resolved. A local box only 1.4x finer than h is mostly swallowed: make it >=1.6x finer (e.g. 0.003 under h 0.005) or drop it; verify via hotspot local h.

[general] One factor per check: mesh 9 changed carrier top and arm size together, so its 2.49% is unattributable. List every difference from the last checked mesh before each check; split if more than one.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Global h was the strongest lever on bc7 (h 0.005 plus boxes beat h 0.0065 plus boxes 0.0028). It is only a hint for other tasks: on the compression task, test h only via peers or one-factor checks.
[general] When a new box flips the mesher onto an expensive branch (neck: 5511->6775 nodes), scan h ±0.0002-0.0005 and box edges ±0.0002 with free mesh() before discarding the target.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Score = 11510/(e% x nodes) while e<3.92%. At 2.45% and 5549 nodes: 0.846. Change pays only if relative e drop >= relative node rise. Floor ~1.1%. Write the number before each step.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] 1.0 mm checkpoint stayed +5.7-5.9% on ~25 meshes (~1.15 pt of mean floor). Choose by checkpoint vectors, not peak PEEQ: a mesh moving only 2-2.5 mm points is the same plateau; one moving the 1.0 mm point is the structural win. Diffs <=0.1 pt are noise.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] CONTROL: h 0.008, order 2, carrier [-0.031,-0.02,-0.0082,0.031,0.032,0.0082] 0.004 r0.004; pockets 0.0025; arms 0.0034; left-pocket extra box 0.0023 r0.003: 5650 nodes, 2.29%, 12.94k (a3 g8, base 0.890, best). Left pocket PEEQ 0.19-0.21 vs 0.286 right.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Assigned variant: change only carrier size 0.004->0.0036, rest of g8 recipe. Carrier is the steep lever (0.0048: 3.37% vs 0.004: 2.30%); finer unchecked. Free-mesh 0.0034-0.0038 first. Gate nodes<=6600, q>=0.15, e<12940/nodes.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Next call: mesh(h=0.008, order=2, carrier [-0.031,-0.02,-0.0082,0.031,0.032,0.0082] 0.0036 r0.004; pockets 0.0025 both sides; arms [0.025,0,..,0.031,0.008,..] and mirrored 0.0034; left pocket 0.0023 r0.003).

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Branch watch: carrier sizes branchy (0.0041->6281, 0.0043->6278, 0.0045->5934, 0.0048->5530 nodes; q 0.1103 common). If finer jumps >6600, shift carrier bottom y -0.02 by ±0.0005 or x-limits ±0.0002, not h (a0's).
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] At carrier 0.0036 arm boxes 0.0034 are likely inert; keep for one-factor attribution.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Check plan: (1) cheapest carrier 0.0036-0.0037 q>=0.15; (2) 0.0034-0.0035 if <=6600 nodes; (3) best at ±0.0002 sibling if q<0.15; (4) g8 control for noise. Use all 6 checks.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] No-carrier fails: h0.005+pockets 6847 nodes q0.18 3.22% (22.0k); h0.006 5266 nodes 3.65%; 1.0 mm point +6.3-6.8%. Error is in arms/bore band y -0.02..0.032. Never drop carrier.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Plateau trims exhausted: slab 0.006 under carrier (y -0.03..-0.02) 5686 nodes 2.30% 13.08k; no arm boxes 5551 nodes 2.36%. Within ±0.1 pt noise; don't recheck.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Before submit list peers' likely recipes from the playbook; slab mesh duplicated a0's exactly (5686 nodes, 0.8799) so no bonus. Never submit a published variant without a unique change.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Unchecked explorer branch: carrier top y 0.012 at h 0.0075 gave 6047 nodes, q 0.11. Hand to a1 or log; don't mix into carrier-size variant.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] 1.0 mm checkpoint stays +5.7% on every carrier mesh; only structural change to mid-ramp plastic zones can move it. Test a 0.003 box on f5 flanks (x ±14-24 mm, y -16..-8 mm) as the single factor.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Diversity: don't end on near-copy of a peer; change structure (neck boxes, thicker carrier, h 0.010) rather than tiny additions.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Idea: coarser global h 0.010 with same carrier and pockets. Free-mesh first; accept only if q>=0.2, nodes down >=15%, e<2.6%.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Carrier top is branchy: y 0.030 gave 6782 nodes, 0.031 6834, 0.032 5549 (q 0.216), 0.033 5623-6834 (q 0.136), 0.035 5737 (q 0.108). Prong tops f17/f34 left outside cost nothing in e. Never request 0.030-0.031.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] a3 neck boxes [±0.024..±0.031, y -0.025..-0.016, full z] 0.0034 r0.003 on 0.032 carrier: 5697 nodes, 2.42% (13.79k) vs 5639/2.55% without. Structural candidate; free-mesh first, require q>=0.2.
